skill-kol-signal.description: Summarize KOL buying and selling on a Solana token over a chosen window, showing buy and sell USD, net flow, a buy/sell dominance label and optional wallet-level activity.
use_cases: Following KOL calls, alert bots, detecting KOL exits.
core_capabilities: Total buy and sell USD from Birdeye-labeled KOL wallets on a Solana token
Net flow with a buy-dominant, sell-dominant or balanced label
Hourly buckets over the last day by default, or your own time range and threshold
Full depth adds a sample of the KOL wallets that traded
